content.stem: 虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)的一名合规经理正在评估其业务及其对反洗钱政策的影响.以下VASP业务的哪些特征会是最令人担忧的？(选择四项.)

options.A: 允许客户交易增强匿名性的代币
options.B: 对境外居民客户的开户服务,包括具有政治公众人物(PEP)身份的客户
options.C: 实现代币在不同区块链之间的转移
options.D: 向在未遵守金融行动特别工作组(FATF)规定的司法管辖区设立的虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)提供服务
options.E: 运营收取高额费用的加密货币自动取款机网络

content.stem_en: A compliance manager at a virtual asset service provider (VASP) is evaluating its business and its impact on AML policies. Which of the following features of the VASP's business would be of greatest concern? (Select Four.)

options_en.A: Allowing clients to transact in anonymity-enhanced tokens
options_en.B: Onboarding clients who are residents abroad, including those with politically exposed person (PEP) status
options_en.C: Enabling transfer of tokens from one blockchain to another
options_en.D: Offering services to VASPs established in jurisdictions that are not FATF compliant
options_en.E: Operating a network of crypto ATMs that charge high fees
